gp.heading: Gross Profit and Margins
gp.text:
For the three months ended September 30, 2026, consolidated gross profit increased by $104,950 to $121,020, representing a total gross margin of 57.1%, compared to a gross profit of $16,070 and a gross margin of 40.6% for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

Our retail trading gross margin for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was 56.6%, representing a significant expansion over the 40.6% retail gross margin in Q3 2025 and the 30.3% margin experienced in the first half of 2026. This margin improvement is directly attributable to the base unit retail price increases implemented at the beginning of 2026, which outpaced our underlying product procurement costs under our distributor arrangement with Related Party B. This structural margin expansion, combined with higher volume, allowed the Company to achieve a positive net income of $8,212 for the third quarter of 2026.

Our service revenue from physical check-ups carries a gross margin of 100% as the underlying operational costs are categorized entirely within localized administrative overhead and general processing expenses.

cor.heading: Cost of revenues
cor.text:
For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company has cost of revenues in the amount of $90,964 and $275,846 respectively. Cost of retail trading revenue was $275,846, while cost of service revenue was $Nil.

For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company has cost of revenues in the amount of $23,534 and $66,682 respectively.

The increase in cost of revenues was directly driven by the increased sales volume of our health supplements and topical creams, which required higher aggregate product fulfillment and delivery expenditures. Cost of retail trading revenue was $275,846 for the nine-month period, tracking our sales performance, while the cost of service revenue was $Nil because the primary processing costs for our physical check-up service line are included in localized administrative overhead.

The cost of retail trading revenue was mainly from the products cost and delivery cost. Currently, our product costs are 60% off of the recommended retail price now. Pursuant to the non-exclusive distributor agreement with related party B, related party B shall have the right to revise products price at any time.

ga.heading: General and Administrative Expenses
ga.text:
For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company incurred general and administrative expenses of $112,808 and $400,909 respectively. These were primarily comprised of staff salary, rental fees, consultancy fees, advertising, professional fees, audit fees, and other fees.

For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company had general and administrative expenses in the amount of $63,915 and $128,297 respectively. These were primarily comprised of consultancy fees, professional fees, audit fees, IT fees, rental fees, building management fee, company incorporation fees, bank charges, filing fee, printing and stationery.

The increase in general and administrative expenses reflects increased operational scale following the structural expansions implemented throughout fiscal year 2026. This operational change was primarily driven by higher ongoing infrastructure costs, including increased staffing, professional fees, advertising and promotional expenses, and consultant outlays required to manage our expanded commercial footprint.

net.heading: Net Income/Loss
net.text:
Our net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $8,212 and net loss for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $191,712 respectively.

Our net loss for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 were $47,845 and $78,999 respectively.

The comparative nine-month increase in net loss reflects the elevated foundational infrastructure expenses incurred during the first half of fiscal year 2026. The Company experienced higher baseline costs for personnel, specialized consulting, corporate compliance, and retail facility leases prior to the full realization of the corresponding retail revenue volumes.

net sales.heading: Revenues
net sales.text:
For the three months ended September 30, 2026, total revenues increased by $172,380, or 435.3%, to $211,984 compared to $39,604 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. This expansion was driven by a $170,019 increase in retail trading revenue and a new $2,361 contribution from our physical check-up service line. The growth in retail trading revenue was driven by a combination of a base unit price increase enacted at the beginning of 2026 and a corresponding increase in customer volumes.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, total revenues increased by $369,063, or 318.2%, to $485,043 compared to $115,980 for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. This cumulative expansion is due to a $358,799 increase in retail product sales to $474,779 and a $10,264 contribution from our new service line. The year-over-year revenue increase across both the three and nine-month periods reflects the full-period compounding effect of our 2026 price increases alongside robust transaction volumes.

For the period ended December 31, 2024, the Company generated total revenue of $ 120,775 , of which no customer accounted for more than 10 % of the Company’s total revenue.
Scientist Home Limited is the sole supplier of our proprietary products and we have been appointed as a non-exclusive distributor since July 16, 2024 through entering into a mutual agreement.
For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company incurred cost of revenues of $ 122,168 , of which a single vendor accounted for more than 10 % of the Company’s cost of revenues.
For the period ended December 31, 2024, the Company incurred cost of revenues of $ 67,865 , accounted by a single vendor.
